responsibility: Implements HPPA’s common target option hook, translating architecture-selection switches such as -march-1.0, -march-1.1, and -march-2.0 and their aliases into the proper PA_11 and PA_20 flag combinations in gcc_options, while also defining the default target/cpu flag baseline. This file centralizes early PA-RISC option normalization for GCC’s shared target framework.
